name: Status lamp beacon post
brief: MK-161 Status lamp beacon post: the base's traffic light for the outside. Three caged glass lamps stacked on a post (green all's well, amber come back soon, red come inside now), a little solar cap and a bell under the lamps. The game lights one lamp and rings the bell, so the whole base mood is read from the world, not a HUD.

rounds.t: First build from the pack style and the Faceted Hero rules, no Midjourney pick yet.
